hero-bg.desc: 首屏背景：暗色记忆星图，teal 光路
hero-bg.prompt: Abstract dark visualization of a living memory graph: hundreds of small luminous nodes connected by thin glowing edges, clustered like constellations, drifting in deep charcoal space. Teal and cyan light paths, a few warm amber accents, subtle volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, ultra-clean minimal composition with empty space on the right for headline text. Cinematic, high-end product key visual, no text, no logos.

prologue-illustration.desc: 序章插图：记忆从噪声中浮现
prologue-illustration.prompt: Editorial illustration: scattered dim memory fragments emerging from soft grey fog and gradually aligning into a clean ordered graph with a few bright teal nodes. Minimal, calm, lots of negative space, subtle grain, muted palette of charcoal, slate, teal and a single warm accent. Concept art for a technical essay, no text.

empty-state.desc: 空图谱占位插画（透明背景）
empty-state.prompt: Minimal line-art illustration of an empty network: three outlined nodes with dashed unfinished edges fading into nothing, single teal accent dot, thin strokes, flat vector aesthetic, transparent background, centered, no text.

og-image.prompt: Wide social share card background: deep charcoal gradient with a delicate teal network of memory nodes across the lower half, soft glow, generous empty space in the upper half, premium minimal tech aesthetic, no text, no logos.
